docs: Services content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of services, each with the name, a line, the price as it is shown and an optional address. One object is valid in every services layout (cards in three or two columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the services, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

description.docs: one line about the service; empty: none

price.docs: the price as it is shown (from 90 000 per project); empty: none

href.docs: the address of the service page; empty: no link
